title: Anxiety and Depression Therapy | Chrysalis Health
description: Individualized anxiety and depression therapy for children, teens, and adults. Assessment, counseling, psychiatric evaluation where appropriate, telehealth and community-based care. Call (888) 587-0335.

faq.q: Can therapy help with anxiety and depression at the same time?
faq.a: Yes. Therapy can address overlapping anxiety and depression symptoms within one individualized treatment plan. A therapist can evaluate how worry, low mood, withdrawal, avoidance, stress, and related concerns interact.

faq.q: What is the difference between anxiety and depression?
faq.a: Anxiety commonly involves persistent worry, fear, tension, or avoidance. Depression commonly involves low mood, reduced interest, hopelessness, or low energy. Symptoms can overlap, and a person may experience both at the same time.

faq.q: What type of therapy is used for anxiety and depression?
faq.a: Treatment may involve cognitive, behavioral, interpersonal, supportive, or other therapeutic approaches. The specific method depends on the client's needs, age, diagnosis, goals, and the qualifications of the assigned therapist.

faq.q: Is medication always needed for anxiety or depression?
faq.a: No. Some people receive therapy without medication. Others may benefit from medication or combined treatment. Treatment recommendations should be based on an individual evaluation.

faq.q: When should someone see a therapist for anxiety or depression?
faq.a: Consider seeking professional support when worry, fear, sadness, irritability, withdrawal, or related concerns persist, become difficult to manage, or interfere with school, work, relationships, sleep, responsibilities, or daily life.

faq.q: Can children and teens receive anxiety and depression therapy?
faq.a: Yes. Treatment can be adjusted for the young person's age, development, symptoms, needs, and environment. Parent or caregiver involvement may be included when appropriate.

faq.q: Is telehealth available for anxiety and depression therapy?
faq.a: Telehealth mental health services may be available depending on the client's location, needs, eligibility, and current program availability. Service options should be confirmed when requesting care.
